fusions.name: Tongue Lash
fusions.desc: Lashes out at an enemy up to 6 tiles away, dealing 6 water damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and slowing it by 25% for 2 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Sudden Splashdown
fusions.desc: You spring up to 6 tiles onto an enemy, then deal 12 water damage to every enemy within 2 tiles of you.

fusions.name: Snapped Fly
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

fusions.name: Squat Lookout
fusions.desc: A bonded bullfrog sits with you, lashing its tongue at enemies within 4 tiles for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds and leaving them [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.
